title: My view
review: Another tough day. With my age and banged up shoulder and long ago injured knee I feel very weak but I enjoyed the past month and can see positive gains. I will continue to go onward and stick with it to see what results I can over a long haul. I think the program is great and hope many seniors can get a real sense of accomplishment. At my age my hope is to maintain and not lose ground. That will be a good benefit for me. Thanks
author: Scott n tott

title: Accessibility
review: I'd like to thank you as a blind person so far the app has worked nicely except for the first two or three screens or pictures a screen reader on an iPhone won't read the pictures. Hopefully things will continue as they are.
author: maryehart

title: Great for Seniors or Beginners
review: This app is perfect for anyone who needs a nice and easy exercise that will bring the results you're wanting! While doing it is seems so easy but the results is amazing! Do it the best you can even if it's not perfect you'll see results!
author: Getnutzangel04
devResponse: Thank you for the 5 stars! We are so happy to hear you love Tai Chi for Seniors and are seeing amazing results from our routines. We built this app exactly for that reason: to provide safe, low-impact, and easy exercises that improve balance, mobility, and joint health for older adults without any pressure. Many people feel intimidated by fitness, but you are proving that gentle, consistent movement is far more important than achieving perfect form.

title: Body moves
review: A good way to move different body parts. Yes I can feel my different parts moving and causing some minor aches and pains but in a good way. I know I am making progress!!! And that is making me happy I started Tai Chi!!!
